test_concat_align: test pl.concat with align strategies to merge dataframes with different columns
test_concat_diagonal: test pl.concat with diagonal strategy to stack dataframes with non-overlapping columns
test_align_frames: test pl.align_frames to align multiple dataframes on a shared key column
test_corr: test pl.corr to compute pearson and spearman correlation between two series
test_coalesce: test pl.coalesce to fill null values with fallback values from multiple columns
test_row_index_expr: test pl.row_index to add sequential row index columns to a dataframe
test_escape_regex: test pl.escape_regex to escape special regex characters in a string
test_first_last: test pl.first and pl.last with ignore_nulls parameter across multiple dtypes
test_count: test pl.count to count non-null values in specified columns
test_cov: test pl.cov to compute covariance between two series with optional ddof
